# Ref. 22's robustness test on the Stage K tapes (generated by `robust_ref22.py`)

Share of 1,000 trials in which the mutant (k successive random single-byte mutations), run for 512 instructions against the all-zero partner, leaves an exact copy of itself in the partner (shift 0). Medians over tapes.

| tapes | n | unmutated tape copies itself exactly | k = 1 | k = 4 | k = 8 | any shift, k = 1 | our single-mutant heritable share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| first replicators (pushers) | 20 | 20 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.002 | 0.967 |
| final dominants with a loop (block copiers) | 12 | 12 | 0.000 | 0.002 | 0.002 | 0.001 | 0.889 |
| final dominants without a loop | 8 | 8 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.001 | 0.969 |

- F1 (block-copy finals more robust than the pushers at every k, by ref. 22's criterion): NOT met
